_rationale: 1000 random pairs of 5-year historical blocks for a 60/40 portfolio with no withdrawals. Real (CPI-deflated) median 60/40 CAGR over rolling 10-year windows in 1928-2024 hovers around 4-6%. With zero spending the balance grows monotonically; a $500k start over ~9 effective years lands in a wide but well-bounded band. probability=100 because zero spending cannot deplete the balance.
